title: Gate a VCF Installer deployment with its specification precheck
prompt: Implement the VCF Installer client workflow in `installer/client.go`. Before implementing, research the `validateSddcSpec` and `deploySddc` operations in official VMware sources. Cite the sources consulted in the final answer. `PrecheckAndDeploy` must first POST the supplied `SddcSpec` to `/v1/sddcs/validations` and may POST it to `/v1/sddcs` only when the returned validation has `executionStatus` `COMPLETED` and `resultStatus` `SUCCEEDED`. Any HTTP error, decode error, nonterminal validation, `FAILED`, `WARNING`, `UNKNOWN`, or cancellation result must stop the workflow without contacting the mutating operation. Use the researched media types and JSON field names. Do not send `deploySddc`'s optional `skipValidations` query parameter when it is unset. All unset optional `SddcSpec` fields, including nested optional fields, must be omitted rather than serialized as empty values. Send the same JSON document to both operations, propagate the caller's context, preserve the exported error types, and decode the documented response types. Keep the implementation safe for concurrent use. Add focused table-driven tests as useful. Run `python3 tests/verifier.py`; it runs the complete suite with the Go race detector.
